name: Gemeinschaftskraftwerk Inn
note: GKI dam at Ovella near the Swiss border with the powerhouse at Prutz; KLIEN books its energy on the upper Inn section up to Pegel Kajetansbruecke (C_current 97 MW) while the powerhouse coordinates fall into section 30300

name: Hieflau
note: Verbund Kraftwerk Hieflau turbines Enns water dammed at the Gesaeuse exit; its coordinates fall into the Erzbach tributary section 50901 (C_current 7.5 MW) while KLIEN books it on the Enns section up to Pegel Grossreifling (C_current 122 MW = Hieflau 63 + Landl 25 + Krippau 30)

name: Amlach
note: TIWAG Kraftwerk Amlach (60 MW) turbines Drau water diverted from Tassenbach through a 22 km tunnel (https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kraftwerk_Amlach); its coordinates in the Drau channel fall outside every KLIEN polygon; pinned to the Drau section up to Pegel Lienz (C_current 63 MW)

name: Weyer
note: Ennskraftwerke Laufkraftwerk Weyer; the relocated coordinates fall into the Gaflenzbach tributary polygon 51101 while KLIEN books the plant on the Enns section up to Pegel Jaegerberg (C_current 261 MW = Weyer + Grossraming + Losenstein + Ternberg + Rosenau + Garsten)

name: Sohlstufe Lehen
note: Salzburg AG Sohlstufe Lehen lies in Salzburg city; the approximate coordinates fall into the downstream section 40700 while KLIEN books it on the Salzach section up to Pegel Salzburg (C_current 61 MW = Urstein + Hallein + Lehen + small plants)

name: Krippau
note: Verbund Laufkraftwerk Krippau; ppm coordinates fall into section 51000 while KLIEN books it on the Enns section up to Pegel Grossreifling (C_current 122 MW = Hieflau 63 + Landl 25 + Krippau 30)

name: Zirknitz
note: KELAG Kraftwerk Zirknitz uses the Grosssee in the Zirknitztal above Grosskirchheim; ppm coordinates fall into section 80602 while the upstream Moell section up to Pegel Winklern (C_current 53 MW) has no other plant of that size

name: Silz Maschine
note: TIWAG Kraftwerksgruppe Sellrain-Silz: the Silz powerhouse stands on the Inn at Silz (section 30500, C_current 13 MW) but turbines the water of the Finstertal and Laengental reservoirs at Kuehtai, which collect the Oetztal side valleys (https://www.tiwag.at/unternehmen/energie-erzeugen/wasserkraft/kraftwerke/kraftwerksgruppe-sellrain-silz/); KLIEN books the group on the Oetztaler Ache section 30407 (C_current 534 MW = Silz 500 + small plants; the Kuehtai pumped-storage stage is excluded)
